about: compiler/ergoversion mutants covering short VCS revisions, pre-release numeric leading zeros, and pre-release vs release precedence

mutants.name: selfhost-ergoversion-of-short-revision
mutants.rule: Of must require at least 12 characters of vcs.revision before formatting a VCS version.

mutants.name: selfhost-ergoversion-valid-pre-leading-zero
mutants.rule: Valid must reject numeric pre-release identifiers with leading zeros while allowing them in build metadata.

mutants.name: selfhost-ergoversion-compare-prerelease-order
mutants.rule: Compare must order a release without pre-release identifiers above the same version with pre-release identifiers.
